job.title: Senior Quantity Surveyor
job.description:
Senior Quantity Surveyor | Data Centre Construction

V7 Recruitment are working with a leading construction and data centre delivery specialist to recruit an experienced Senior Quantity Surveyor to join their project delivery team in Vaasa, Finland and Kristiansand, Norway.
This is an excellent opportunity to take a senior commercial role on a large-scale, technically complex data centre project. You will take ownership of the commercial and contractual management of the project, working closely with the Contracts Manager, Project Manager and wider delivery team.

What's On Offer
  • Competitive salary €100,000 - €125,000
  • 3 weeks on / 1 week off rotation
  • Full relocation support available
  • Flights and shared accommodation provided
  • Daily allowance of approximately €50–€60
  • Shared car hire
  • Pension and standard benefits
  • Major, high-profile construction projects
  • Strong career development opportunities
The Role
  • Take ownership of the commercial strategy and financial performance of the project.
  • Lead procurement, subcontractor selection, negotiations and final accounts.
  • Manage project costs, valuations, forecasting and cashflow.
  • Oversee variations, change control, claims and commercial entitlement.
  • Manage commercial risks and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Ensure contractual compliance and protect the company’s commercial position.
  • Provide accurate commercial reporting to senior management.
  • Support and mentor junior Quantity Surveyors and commercial staff.
  • Build strong relationships with clients, consultants and subcontractors.
What We're Looking For
  • Degree qualified in Quantity Surveying or a related discipline.
  • Significant experience as a Quantity Surveyor on large-scale construction projects.
  • Strong experience across cost management, procurement, contracts and change control.
  • Experience delivering complex design and build projects and high-value contracts.
  • Strong knowledge of construction contracts, ideally including NEC and JCT.
  • Data centre, mission-critical or other technically complex project experience would be highly advantageous.
  • Strong commercial awareness, negotiation and stakeholder management skills.
  • Proven experience supporting and developing junior commercial staff.
  • Chartered membership of RICS, CIOB or equivalent would be advantageous.
V7 Recruitment is an equal opportunities employer. All applications are considered based on merit and suitability for the role.

job.title: Lead Planner
job.description:
Project Planner | Data Centre Construction

V7 Recruitment are working with a leading construction and data centre delivery specialist to recruit an experienced Project Planner to join their growing project delivery team in Copenhagen, Denmark

This is an excellent opportunity for a Planner with construction experience to work on large-scale, technically complex data centre projects. You will play a key role in developing, managing and monitoring project programmes across design, procurement, construction, commissioning and handover.

What's On Offer
  • Competitive salary €75,000 - €100,000
  • 3 weeks on / 1 week off rotation
  • Full relocation support available
  • Flights and shared accommodation provided
  • Daily allowance of approximately €50–€60
  • Shared car hire
  • Pension and standard benefits
  • Major, high-profile construction projects
  • Strong career development opportunities
The Role
  • Develop and manage baseline and target construction programmes using Primavera P6 and/or Asta Powerproject.
  • Monitor programme progress, critical paths, risks and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Produce detailed progress reports, tracking schedules and programme updates for project stakeholders.
  • Develop construction methodologies, sequencing and phasing plans alongside project teams.
  • Coordinate with subcontractors and the supply chain to incorporate design, procurement and construction activities.
  • Support change management by assessing programme impacts and advising on potential delays.
  • Produce as-built programmes and analyse deviations from the project baseline.
  • Lead weekly and monthly programme reporting.
  • Support pre-construction and tender planning activities.
  • Mentor and support junior and graduate planners.
What We're Looking For
  • Degree or diploma in Construction Management, Civil Engineering, Project Management or a related discipline.
  • Experience in construction planning and programme management on large-scale projects.
  • Strong proficiency in Primavera P6 and/or Asta Powerproject.
  • Experience developing and managing programmes across design, procurement and construction phases.
  • Strong understanding of construction methodologies, sequencing and critical path analysis.
  • Experience with data centres, mission-critical or other technically complex projects would be highly advantageous.
  • Knowledge of NEC, JCT or FIDIC contracts would be beneficial.
  • Experience with BIM, Synchro, 4D planning or collaborative data platforms would be advantageous.
  • Strong analytical, communication and stakeholder management skills.

You’ll be joining a well-established, family-owned construction business with a global reach and a strong track record of delivering some of Europe’s most significant construction projects.

  • 3 weeks on / 1 week off rotational model.

  • Flights covered.

  • Pension and standard benefits package.

  • Strong opportunities for career development and progression.

job.title: Senior Planner - Vaasa
job.description:
V7 Recruitment are working with a leading European data centre delivery specialist who are looking to appoint an experienced Senior Planner to join their growing project team in Vaasa, Finland.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Planner to take ownership of major project programmes while working on some of the largest and most technically complex data centre developments in Europe.

🔹 The Role
As Senior Planner, you will take responsibility for developing and managing project programmes across the full project lifecycle, from pre-construction and procurement through to construction and commissioning.

You will also play a key role in client engagement, team leadership, bid planning and the continuous improvement of project controls.
Key responsibilities will include:
  • Developing detailed bid programmes to support tender and bid submissions.
  • Developing, maintaining and reviewing detailed master construction programmes.
  • Establishing and managing project controls procedures for live projects.
  • Preparing and presenting programme and progress reviews to senior management.
  • Leading, mentoring and supporting a team of ambitious engineers.
  • Taking ownership of the project programme and supporting other projects where required.
  • Working closely with key stakeholders to monitor progress and proactively identify risks.
  • Supporting effective problem-solving and programme recovery.
  • Developing and maintaining schedules across pre-construction, construction and commissioning.
  • Ensuring accurate and up-to-date progress reporting.
  • Representing the Planning function at client and subcontractor meetings.
  • Building and maintaining long-term client relationships.
  • Supporting account management and wider business development activities.
  • Contributing to continuous improvement across planning and project controls.
🔹 About You
We're looking for a Senior Planner with:
  • A degree in Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline.
  • 5+ years' relevant construction planning experience.
  • Experience working within a main contractor environment would be highly advantageous.
  • Strong experience developing and managing complex construction programmes.
  • Proficiency in Primavera P6 and/or Asta Powerproject.
  • Experience with BIM and digital construction workflows.
  • Experience working within large-scale, technically complex projects.
  • Strong leadership and mentoring capabilities.
  • Excellent client-facing and stakeholder management skills.
  • A proactive, autonomous and results-driven approach.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • The ability to manage multiple priorities within challenging project environments.
  • Data centre, mission-critical or high-tech industrial experience would be particularly advantageous.
🔹 What's On Offer?

✅ Opportunity to work on some of Europe's largest data centre projects
✅ Major technically complex construction programmes
✅ Competitive salary and benefits package

job.description:

Must be a British passport holder

We are recruiting experienced Uk based Quantity Surveyors to support Data Centre construction in Skellefteå, Sweden.  This is an excellent opportunity for a Quantity Surveyor to support the commercial delivery of a large-scale data centre project, working closely with the wider project and commercial teams to control costs, manage contracts and maximise value.

  • Salary upto €100,000 DOE

  • Good understanding of cost control, procurement and contract administration.

job.title: Planner - Hamina, Finland
job.description:
V7 Recruitment are currently working with a leading European data centre delivery specialist who are looking to appoint two experienced Project Schedulers / Planners to support major new projects across Finland and Norway.

We have two positions available:
🇫🇮 Hamina, Finland 
🇳🇴 Skien, Norway 

These are excellent opportunities for experienced Planners looking to work on large-scale, technically complex construction projects within the rapidly expanding data centre sector.

The Role

As Project Scheduler, you will be responsible for developing and managing project programmes, monitoring progress and working closely with the wider project team to ensure key milestones are achieved.

Key responsibilities will include:
  • Developing and maintaining detailed construction programmes.
  • Managing project schedules throughout the delivery lifecycle.
  • Monitoring progress against programme milestones.
  • Identifying potential delays, risks and programme impacts.
  • Working closely with Project Managers, site teams, subcontractors and other stakeholders.
  • Reviewing and coordinating subcontractor programmes.
  • Supporting short-, medium- and long-term planning.
  • Analysing critical paths and programme performance.
  • Producing regular progress reports and schedule updates.
  • Supporting programme recovery and mitigation strategies where required.
  • Ensuring planning information is accurate, current and aligned with project objectives.
About You

We're looking for experienced construction Planners/Schedulers with:
  • Strong Primavera P6 experience.
  • Previous experience planning complex construction projects.
  • Experience working on projects such as data centres, mission-critical facilities, major hotels, airports or similarly complex developments.
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing and programme management.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • The ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary project teams.
  • Candidates must already be based in the relevant country – Finland or Norway.
Package
  • Fixed-term contract arrangement through a local Employer of Record
  • Accommodation/digs covered while working on site, Monday–Friday

job.title: Project Planner
job.description:
V7 Recruitment are working with a leading European data centre delivery specialist who are looking to appoint an experienced Project Planner to join their team in Skelleftea, Sweden.

This is a fantastic opportunity to work on a major hyperscale data centre development, comprising two 74MW facilities, with the overall programme expected to run for approximately 8–9 years.

For the right candidate, this offers long-term project security, excellent earning potential and the opportunity to work on one of the largest data centre developments in the region.

The Role
As Project Planner, you will play a key role in supporting the planning and programme management of the project, working closely with Project Managers, Package Managers, design teams and subcontractors.

Package
  • Salary up to €110,000
  • €265 net weekly allowance
  • 5–20% discretionary annual bonus based on project performance
  • Flights covered
  • Furnished single-occupancy accommodation OR approximately €1,900 per month accommodation allowance
  • Shared vehicle for travel to site
  • 25 days' holiday + bank holidays
  • €150 health membership voucher
  • Pension scheme

Key responsibilities include:
  • Developing and maintaining detailed project schedules aligned with project objectives.
  • Supporting planning activities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Monitoring progress and identifying programme risks, delays and potential impacts.
  • Coordinating with Project Managers, Package Managers, design teams and subcontractors.
  • Supporting the preparation and updating of short- and long-term construction programmes.
  • Tracking progress against key milestones and reporting programme performance.
  • Attending planning meetings, progress meetings and project reviews.
  • Analysing critical paths and identifying opportunities for programme optimisation.
  • Reviewing subcontractor programmes and ensuring alignment with the overall project schedule.
  • Producing regular progress reports and schedule updates.
  • Supporting programme-related inputs for claims and variations.
  • Maintaining accurate planning documentation.
  • Supporting the resolution of scheduling and coordination issues.
About You

We're looking for a Planner with:
  • 4+ years' experience in project planning within construction or engineering.
  • A degree in Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline.
  • Experience developing and managing construction programmes.
  • Strong proficiency in Primavera P6, Microsoft Project or similar planning software.
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing and project delivery.
  • Excellent analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • The ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary project team.
  • Data centre, industrial or mission-critical experience would be highly advantageous.

Rotation Options3 Weeks On / 4 Days Off

Work across Monday–Saturday during the first two weeks, followed by Monday–Wednesday during Week 3, before travelling home for Thursday–Sunday off.

5 Weeks On / 1 Week Off

Work Monday–Saturday across the five-week rotation, with travel home on Saturday and a full week off before returning to site.

Why Skelleftea?

Skelleftea offers a very different experience from many traditional data centre locations.

The area is known for its strong community, safety, good schools and excellent quality of life, making it particularly attractive for candidates considering a longer-term relocation with their family.
You'll also experience the unique Swedish seasons, with long summer evenings and the opportunity to see the Northern Lights during the winter months.

Why This Opportunity?This is more than simply another planning position.

You'll be joining a long-term, high-value hyperscale data centre programme, gaining exposure to complex construction delivery and working alongside experienced project professionals on a major European development.
If you're an experienced Project Planner looking for a new challenge in the data centre sector and are open to working in Sweden, V7 Recruitment would like to hear from you.

Apply now or contact V7 Recruitment for a confidential discussion.

job.title: M&E Senior Quantity Surveyor
job.description:
Our client is a forward-thinking and rapidly growing M&E contractor delivering bespoke high-rise residential and commercial schemes. Due to an increase in workload, they are looking for a Quantity Surveyor and Senior Quantity Surveyor to join their team in Manchester.
In return, my client is offering:
  • Competitive salary
  • Car allowance
  • Bonus scheme
  • Generous holiday allowance
  • Healthcare
  • Pension matched at 6%
  • Regular social events
Ideal candidate:
  • Experience working on high-rise residential and/or commercial developments
  • Strong M&E quantity surveying background
  • Experience managing projects from pre-construction through to final account
  • Strong commercial, negotiation and communication skills
  • Able to work independently while building effective relationships with site and operational teams
Duties will include:
  • Commercially delivering M&E projects from inception through to completion.

  • Developing and managing project revenue and cash-flow forecasts.

  • Supporting and mentoring junior members of the commercial team where required.
This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking for a fresh challenge with a company that offers autonomy, progression and exposure to high-profile projects.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
- Project Manager
- £45k–£55k + Bonus, 25 days holiday, pension & LOTS of career opportunities
- Hybrid
 
How does joining a world-leading engineering organisation sound?
We design, manufacture and deliver high-end engineered products used all over the world, working with clients across a range of sectors. And when projects can be worth anywhere from £100k to £1m+, making sure everything runs smoothly from sale to dispatch is pretty important.

That’s where you come in…

We’re looking for a Project Manager to take ownership of these projects from start to finish — coordinating Sales, Design, Production, Finance and Logistics, while keeping the client informed every step of the way.
 
Why this role?
This isn’t just about managing a project plan. You’ll be the person joining all the dots, solving issues, keeping teams aligned and making sure the customer gets exactly what they’ve ordered, when they expect it.

You’ll typically manage 5–10 projects at once, ranging from 8–24 weeks in duration. Most are worth £100k–£1m, with some reaching as high as £7m.
 
What are we looking for?
Ideally, you’ll have a technical or engineering background alongside solid project management experience. You don’t need to know our products — we’ll teach you that.

What matters is that you can manage multiple projects, communicate confidently, work across different teams and keep things moving.

And with the company growing rapidly as part of a much larger global group, there’s plenty of scope to progress your career, including potential opportunities across Europe.
 
Sound like your kind of opportunity?
Hit apply and let’s have a chat. I’d love to hear your story. :::

job.description:

- Perfect for someone from an engineering / technical background
- Hybrid working model
- £45k - £55k & bonus, 25 day holiday, pension & career opportunities
 
How does coming into a world leading engineering organization sound?

To set the scene, we design, produce & manufacture (on site) a range of high-end engineered products that are found all around the world. A range of clients use our products in a range of different sectors. And getting these projects right from sales to dispatch are essential.

That’s where you come in…

job.title: CSA Construction Manager
job.description:
Our client is a dedicated data centre delivery partner providing turnkey solutions to our clients, headquartered in Dublin and delivering throughout Europe.
They specialise in providing turnkey data centre solutions, providing services from design, through to construction across the full range of civil, structural, architectural, mechanical and electrical services as well as commissioning.
Having grown to become the leading and most trusted company in our sector and is the only dedicated Data Centre delivery partner in Europe.
We are currently constructing multiple turnkey data centre projects in 7 different European countries, equating to over 430 MW of IT load in flight.
To support our growth, we are hiring an ambitious and forward thinking CSA Construction Manager to join our established but growing team in Sweden. The role will require you to manage the CSA construction team to safeguard a successful project execution and development.

Requirements
  • Manage the co-ordination of the Civil, Structural, and Architectural work packages.
  • Manage and support the CSA team (supervisors, engineers, and package managers) in their roles to successfully deliver the CSA scope on a fast track and technical project.
  • Manage site safety in conjunction with the Project Manager and Project Safety Team.
  • Manage and drive a strong culture with regards Quality, Health & Safety and Environmental matters within your team.
  • Planning and monitoring of procurement, design, engineering, and installation aspects for all CSA works.
  • Develop a project delivery strategy for the CSA work. Support the commercial team to create ‘Scope of Work’ documents and sub-contract packages for sub-contract enquiries and appointments.
  • Review client design, highlight discrepancies or deviation from local and international standards whilst leading successful resolution too. Protect the company’s commercial and contractual position in all instances.
  • Develop and manage a detailed site plan regarding Quality Assurance (QA) and Quality Control in conjunction with our QA/QC team to ensure project compliance is achieved.
  • Manage ‘day to day’ site operations regarding onsite management of contractors, in particular Health & Safety and Quality Assurance/Control.
  • Manage of Project Schedule in conjunction with our Project Planning team, Project Managers, and Sub-Contractors.
  • Liaise with design team and project design manager to ensure necessary information (as required by construction team) is prioritised (where necessary) is issued and aligns with our construction schedule.
  • Manage sub-contractor activities including tracking progress against schedule and appropriate resource levels.
  • Chairing and hosting weekly progress meetings with each CSA supply chain member.
  • Manage and ensure all sub-contractor documentation is well maintained, current, and filed accordingly for future reference.
  • Attendance at Site Meetings, Internal Project Reviews, Design and Engineering Reviews, Planning and Co-ordination Meetings and Handover Meetings.
  • Manage close-out of all project items including, Punch List, Safety File, QA File, and Project Plan.
  • Ability to think methodically whilst possessing strong problem-solving skills to resolve design and site challenges.
  • Issue daily and weekly reports to the project management team members
  • Attend and support commercial meetings to ensure all variations are considered, allowing the commercial team to issue and manage client change.
  • Review drawings and setting out information.
  • Ensure ‘builders works’ drawings in connection with MEP services are considered, coordinated, and incorporated where required.

Skills/Qualifications:
  • Relevant Construction degree qualification or similar
  • At least 7 years of CSA construction site experience.
  • Strong background in managing and successfully completing CSA work packages.
  • Ability to maintain an overview of entire project whilst managing all technical aspects.
  • Experience in scheduling, programming, and sequencing, including 4 and 12 week look-ahead forecasts.
  • Experience in effectively managing internal construction teams.
  • Experience in delivery of large-scale projects

Benefits
  • Working on large scale data centre projects
  • Collaborative team working environments
  • Career progression and development supported
  • Competitive salary packages with rotational rosters

job.title: Electronic Design Engineer
job.description:
- Electronic Design Engineer  
- Fully remote role  
- Working for UK leading engineering company in their sector
- £45k -50k, 25 day holiday, bonus, pension & more
 
How does designing products & solutions for a hugely established yet growing engineering & manufacturing business sound?

To set the scene, we are the UK leader in our sector and see our products go all over the world in a range of different sectors. But as we are continuing to grow & evolve, we need to add to our design team to keep up with our high level projects.

That’s where you come in…

So a newly created role to design new products and improve our existing ones working with some really heavy hitting clients along the way and working with our senior designer who can guide, train and mentor you.

And the role is fully remote so you can be anywhere in the UK, which is always a bonus.
 
The person:
We’re open here – but someone who has a good Electronic Design background and who wants to continue that journey designing our new products as well as improving and evolving our current range on some really tasty projects.

Our products can be found in a range of different sectors, so your background that side isn’t important, but someone who has good circuit design, PCB layout and embedded C or C++ firmware.

And is happy to work remotely from home – although you’re welcome on to our sites any time for a cup of tea!
 
The role:
As alluded to, we’re super busy. We’ve expanded on our manufacturing site (again), we’ve grown our workforce across the board and that shows no signs of slowing down. With that, we have to expand our design function on new & existing design projects.

So you will be turning product requirements into specifications and test plans, then select components and design schematics and PCBs for analogue, digital, power and interface circuits.

We already have a senior designer who can help & train you where needed, so lots of development for you too.

job.description:
V7 Recruitment are recruiting for a Logistics Manager on behalf of a leading international data centre contractor delivering major hyperscale projects across Europe.

In return they are offering: 
  • Competitive Salary
  • Bonus Scheme
  • Flights/Accommodation
  • Subsistence Allowance
  • Pension Scheme

  • Bachelor’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Construction Management, or similar discipline
  •  Minimum 5 - 7 years’ experience in a logistics role within construction or engineering
  • Strong experience managing site logistics on large-scale construction projects
  • Knowledge of traffic management, material handling, and site coordination practices
  • Excellent organisational and planning skills
  • Strong communication and stakeholder coordination abilities
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced site environment
  • Strong understanding of health & safety requirements related to site logistics
  • Data centre, industrial, or mission-critical project experience is advantageous

  • Lead and manage all site logistics activities across the project lifecycle
  • Develop and implement site logistics plans in line with project requirements
  • Coordinate deliveries, material handling, and site movements to ensure efficiency and minimal disruption
  • Manage site access, traffic management, and security in line with health & safety standards
  • Coordinate with Project Managers, Package Managers, subcontractors, and suppliers to align logistics with the project programme
  • Monitor and control storage areas, ensuring materials are stored safely and efficiently
  • Manage logistics subcontractors, including performance tracking and coordination meetings
  • Ensure all logistics documentation, permits, and safety records are maintained and up to date
  • Attend Site Meetings, Planning Meetings, and Logistics Coordination Meetings
  • Identify and mitigate logistical risks, including congestion, delays, and site constraints
  • Support the project team in maintaining a safe and organised working environment
  • Prepare and issue logistics reports to the project team and senior management
  • Ensure compliance with company procedures and health & safety regulations
  • Proactively identify and resolve logistics and coordination issues on site

job.description:
V7 Recruitment are recruiting for a QA/QC CSA Engineer on behalf of a leading international data centre contractor delivering major hyperscale Data Centre projects in Skelleftea.This is a fantastic opportunity to join a high-performing project team and play a key role in ensuring all Civil, Structural and Architectural (CSA) works are delivered to the highest standards of quality, compliance, and client satisfaction.

  • Subsistence Allowance

  • Degree qualified in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.

job.title: KVV Supervisor (Underground Services) Data Centre
job.description:
KVV / Underground Services Supervisor: Data Centre

Location: Finland
Project: 150MW Data Centre
Contract: 18 Months
Employment Type: Contract
Reporting To: MEP / Construction Project Lead
Representing: Project Management Consultancy (PMC) / End Client

The Role We are currently recruiting for a KVV / Underground Services Supervisor to join the site delivery team on a major 150MW hyperscale data centre project in Finland.

The successful candidate will work for the Project Management Consultancy (PMC), representing the end client on site, and will be responsible for the day-to-day supervision, coordination and quality control of underground KVV and associated external services across the project.

This is a site-based position working alongside the client, PMC, main contractor and specialist subcontractors to ensure underground services are delivered safely, to programme and in accordance with the approved design, specifications and project standards.

Key Responsibilities
  • Supervise the installation and delivery of underground KVV / external utility services on the data centre project.

  • Monitor subcontractor activities and ensure works are completed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications and method statements.

  • Coordinate underground services with civil, structural, electrical and mechanical workstreams.

  • Review and monitor installation sequences, technical documentation and construction methodologies.

  • Carry out regular site inspections to verify quality, progress and compliance.

  • Identify design, coordination and construction issues and work with the relevant project teams to resolve them.

  • Monitor trenching, excavation, pipework, drainage and associated underground infrastructure where applicable.

  • Ensure required inspections, testing and documentation are completed throughout the works.

  • Review subcontractor progress and provide regular updates to the PMC project management team.

  • Coordinate interfaces between underground services and other site infrastructure.

  • Support the management of permits, inspections, approvals and technical queries relating to underground services.

  • Ensure all works are undertaken in accordance with project HSE requirements and Finnish regulations.

  • Monitor the production of as-built information and handover documentation.

  • Attend coordination and progress meetings with the client, PMC, main contractor and subcontractors.

  • Support commissioning and final completion activities relating to underground services where required.

Requirements
  • Proven experience in KVV, underground services, utilities or civil infrastructure supervision.

  • Previous experience working as a Supervisor, Foreman, Site Manager, Project Engineer, Infrastructure Supervisor or similar.

  • Strong understanding of underground utility installation and site infrastructure.

  • Experience coordinating subcontractors and multiple construction disciplines.

  • Ability to interpret construction drawings, specifications and technical documentation.

  • Strong understanding of construction quality, safety and inspection processes.

  • Excellent communication and coordination skills.

  • Previous experience on large-scale commercial, industrial, infrastructure or data centre projects is highly desirable.

  • Experience working in a client-side, PMC or consultancy environment would be advantageous.

  • Finnish construction experience and knowledge of local standards/regulations would be beneficial.

Desirable Experience Candidates with experience in any of the following areas will be particularly relevant:

  • Underground water and sewer services

  • Drainage and stormwater systems

  • External utility networks

  • Site-wide infrastructure

  • Underground pipework

  • Civil infrastructure and earthworks

  • Utility coordination

  • Large-scale industrial or mission-critical projects

Due to continued growth, they're looking to appoint an experienced Health & Safety Advisor to support and drive their Health & Safety strategy across a national portfolio of projects.

This is a fantastic opportunity to join a respected and forward-thinking organisation where you'll have the opportunity to influence Health & Safety standards, work closely with senior stakeholders and project teams, and play a key role in embedding a proactive and positive safety culture across the business.

  • Competitive salary

job.title: Substation Project Manager: Giga
job.description:
Substation Project Manager – Data Centre Construction
Location: Finland
Contract: Long-term contract opportunity
Sector: Data Centre / Mission Critical
Recruitment: V7 Recruitment – Confidential Client

V7 Recruitment is currently supporting a confidential client on a major hyperscale data centre development in Finland.

We are seeking an experienced Substation Project Manager to oversee the planning, coordination and execution of substation and associated electrical infrastructure works supporting the delivery of a major mission-critical data centre facility.

This is a key project leadership position, responsible for ensuring the substation package is delivered safely, on programme, to budget and in accordance with the required technical, quality and performance standards.

The successful candidate will work closely with design teams, contractors, utility providers, vendors, commissioning specialists and wider project stakeholders throughout construction, testing, energisation and handover.

Key Responsibilities
1. Project Management & Coordination
Lead and manage the full lifecycle of the substation package from pre-construction through construction, commissioning, energisation and handover.

Develop and manage project schedules, milestones and deliverables in line with the overall data centre programme.

Coordinate cross-functional teams across civil, structural, electrical, design and commissioning disciplines.

Manage key interfaces between the substation works and wider data centre electrical infrastructure.

Maintain effective communication across all project stakeholders.

Lead project progress meetings, site inspections and coordination meetings.

2. Construction Execution
Oversee day-to-day construction activities to ensure alignment with project plans, programme and technical requirements.

Coordinate contractors, subcontractors and vendors to ensure works are delivered safely and to the required quality standards.

Review construction drawings, RFIs, technical submittals and method statements.

Monitor contractor performance, construction progress and key project milestones.

Coordinate construction sequencing and interfaces between civil, structural and electrical works.

Identify programme risks and develop appropriate mitigation strategies.

3. Stakeholder, Quality & Risk Management
Act as a key point of contact for contractors, consultants, utility providers and vendors involved in the substation works.

Ensure effective coordination between design engineers, construction teams and commissioning specialists.

Implement quality control processes to ensure high-standard delivery of all works.

Ensure compliance with project specifications, client requirements, relevant regulations and industry standards.

Identify and manage technical, construction and programme risks.

Provide regular project updates and progress reports to project leadership and client stakeholders.

4. Testing, Energisation & Handover
Coordinate testing, commissioning and energisation activities with contractors, utility providers, vendors and commissioning teams.

Ensure all required inspections, testing and documentation are completed prior to energisation.

Ensure equipment and systems meet operational and performance requirements.

Support integrated testing of associated electrical infrastructure where required.

Manage close-out documentation including test records, O&M manuals, as-built drawings, warranties and asset registers.

Support operations teams during handover and transition into the live environment.

Required Qualifications & Experience
Essential
Proven experience delivering complex HV substations, electrical infrastructure or major power distribution projects.

Strong knowledge of HV/MV systems, substations, transformers, switchgear and electrical distribution infrastructure.

Strong project management experience across programme, cost, risk and quality.

Proven ability to lead contractors and manage multiple project stakeholders.

Experience managing construction activities, technical interfaces and contractor performance.

Knowledge of testing, commissioning and energisation processes.

Strong understanding of electrical safety requirements and relevant industry standards.

Desirable
Previous experience within hyperscale or colocation data centre construction.

Experience managing utility interfaces and grid connection requirements.

Previous experience delivering major substation or power infrastructure projects in Finland.

Knowledge of Finnish regulations, building codes and relevant industry standards.

Key Personal Attributes
Strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

Comfortable working within a fast-paced and technically complex project environment.

High attention to detail and commitment to quality.

Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.

Collaborative approach with the ability to build effective relationships across multiple project teams.

Resilient, adaptable and capable of managing competing priorities.

Strong integrity and commitment to health, safety and quality.

The Opportunity
This is an opportunity to join a major mission-critical data centre development in Finland, taking ownership of a critical substation package from construction through to energisation and handover.

Client details and full project information will be shared confidentially with suitable candidates by V7 Recruitment.

If you have the relevant substation, HV/MV or major power infrastructure experience and would like to discuss the opportunity, please get in touch with V7 Recruitment for further details.

job.title: Project Planner
job.description:
V7 Recruitment are working with a leading European data centre delivery specialist who are looking to appoint an experienced Project Planner to join their team in Skelleftea, Sweden.

This is a fantastic opportunity to work on a major hyperscale data centre development, comprising two 74MW facilities, with the overall programme expected to run for approximately 8–9 years.

For the right candidate, this offers long-term project security, excellent earning potential and the opportunity to work on one of the largest data centre developments in the region.

The Role
As Project Planner, you will play a key role in supporting the planning and programme management of the project, working closely with Project Managers, Package Managers, design teams and subcontractors.

Package
  • Salary up to €110,000
  • €265 net weekly allowance
  • 5–20% discretionary annual bonus based on project performance
  • Flights covered
  • Furnished single-occupancy accommodation OR approximately €1,900 per month accommodation allowance
  • Shared vehicle for travel to site
  • 25 days' holiday + bank holidays
  • €150 health membership voucher
  • Pension scheme

Key responsibilities include:
  • Developing and maintaining detailed project schedules aligned with project objectives.
  • Supporting planning activities throughout the project lifecycle.
  • Monitoring progress and identifying programme risks, delays and potential impacts.
  • Coordinating with Project Managers, Package Managers, design teams and subcontractors.
  • Supporting the preparation and updating of short- and long-term construction programmes.
  • Tracking progress against key milestones and reporting programme performance.
  • Attending planning meetings, progress meetings and project reviews.
  • Analysing critical paths and identifying opportunities for programme optimisation.
  • Reviewing subcontractor programmes and ensuring alignment with the overall project schedule.
  • Producing regular progress reports and schedule updates.
  • Supporting programme-related inputs for claims and variations.
  • Maintaining accurate planning documentation.
  • Supporting the resolution of scheduling and coordination issues.
About You

We're looking for a Planner with:
  • 4+ years' experience in project planning within construction or engineering.
  • A degree in Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline.
  • Experience developing and managing construction programmes.
  • Strong proficiency in Primavera P6, Microsoft Project or similar planning software.
  • Strong understanding of construction sequencing and project delivery.
  • Excellent analytical, organisational and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • The ability to work effectively within a multidisciplinary project team.
  • Data centre, industrial or mission-critical experience would be highly advantageous.

Rotation Options3 Weeks On / 4 Days Off

Work across Monday–Saturday during the first two weeks, followed by Monday–Wednesday during Week 3, before travelling home for Thursday–Sunday off.

5 Weeks On / 1 Week Off

Work Monday–Saturday across the five-week rotation, with travel home on Saturday and a full week off before returning to site.

Why Skelleftea?

Skelleftea offers a very different experience from many traditional data centre locations.

The area is known for its strong community, safety, good schools and excellent quality of life, making it particularly attractive for candidates considering a longer-term relocation with their family.
You'll also experience the unique Swedish seasons, with long summer evenings and the opportunity to see the Northern Lights during the winter months.

Why This Opportunity?This is more than simply another planning position.

You'll be joining a long-term, high-value hyperscale data centre programme, gaining exposure to complex construction delivery and working alongside experienced project professionals on a major European development.
If you're an experienced Project Planner looking for a new challenge in the data centre sector and are open to working in Sweden, V7 Recruitment would like to hear from you.

Apply now or contact V7 Recruitment for a confidential discussion.

job.title: Commissioning Manager
job.description:
V7 Recruitment is working with a leading international engineering and construction contractor delivering some of Europe's most complex mission critical and data centre projects. Due to continued growth, they are looking to appoint an experienced Commissioning Manager to join a flagship project in Frankfurt. This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in the successful delivery of a major data centre development, leading commissioning activities from planning through to handover while managing multidisciplinary teams and stakeholder relationships.

What's on offer:
  • Competitive Salary
  • Discretionary Bonus Scheme
  • Subsistence Allowance
  • Flights/Accommodation/Car hire
  • Annual Leave
  • Pension Scheme

Requirements: 
  • Degree qualification in Mechanical Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience.
  • Minimum 5 years' experience in commissioning leadership roles within mission critical, data centre, industrial or large-scale construction projects.
  • Strong understanding of commissioning processes, programmes, procedures and documentation.
  • Experience managing vendor relationships and witnessing FAT/FWT activities.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple stakeholders and maintain strong client relationships.
  • Excellent programme and deadline management skills.
  • Strong communication and leadership capabilities.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced project environment and work effectively under pressure.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Lead and manage a team of Commissioning Engineers and Package Engineers.
  • Define commissioning scope and oversee delivery against project requirements.
  • Develop, manage and track commissioning programmes, milestones and critical deadlines.
  • Ensure all commissioning activities are delivered in line with contractual requirements and project procedures.
  • Coordinate and manage vendor FATs (Factory Acceptance Testing) and FWTs (Factory Witness Testing).

  • Act as the key point of contact for all commissioning stakeholders, including clients, vendors, contractors and internal teams.
  • Chair and contribute to daily and weekly commissioning meetings.
  • Monitor progress, identify risks and implement mitigation strategies to achieve programme objectives.
  • Support project handover and closeout activities.

job.description:
- Mechanical Project Engineer
- Data Centre project
- Ideally Data Centre experience, but can look at Mission Critical, MEP, infrastructure, construction background
- £70k - £80k &, bonus, 22 day holiday, accommodation, Mon - Fri working week

You may have heard, but that data centre world is on the crest of a wave…

If ever there was a sector to be in, it is the data centre sector with billions invested all around Europe. With so much money being spent on some of the most exciting projects across the world, the world as we know it is evolving around us. But with all this excitement, the M&E has to be perfect in these facilities or else they just won’t work.

On that basis, we are looking for a Mechanical Engineer on a hyperscale data centre build in the Northeast A project that is due to go on for years on 1 of the biggest projects of its kind across the UK.

So a chance to use your current expertise, add to that experience & skillset and leave your mark on the Data Centre revolution. Something to tell the grandchildren…

The person:
We are open here – ideally we’d like Data Centre experience, but we can look at sharp mechanical professionals who have worked in Mission Critical before (so MEP, pharma, construction, power stations etc).

So it could be a perfect way into this lucrative new world to evolve your skillset in Data Centres or you can use your existing Data Centre knowledge and bring it to a hyperscale long-term project.

Getting the right “person” which is what we’re about – someone who wants to really add value to this huge, long-term project.

The role:
As this data centre is constructed and delivered, we need the engineering geniuses to make sure it all “works” stage by stage.

This will be supporting and coordinating the delivery of the electrical works into this project, working with the wider team to make sure all is on track and all is up to the quality standards needed.

What next?

job.title: Multi-skilled Engineer TS/NE
job.description:
Service & Maintenance Engineer – Emergency Lighting & Fire Alarms (Subcontract)

V7 are seeking skilled Service & Maintenance Engineers to work on a large-scale public sector project in the North East. This is a long-running contract with our national client, offering consistent, ongoing work and great potential for long-term subcontract opportunities. The role involves servicing and maintaining emergency lighting systems and fire alarm systems across a range of public buildings, including housing, education facilities, and care environments.

Role Overview
  • Carry out routine servicing, testing, and compliance checks on emergency lighting in line with BS 5266.
  • Service, fault-find, and repair both addressable and conventional fire alarm systems in accordance with BS 5839.
  • Respond to reactive maintenance calls and complete remedial works where necessary.
  • Provide clear service reports and communicate findings with site contacts.
  • Ensure all work is carried out to relevant industry standards and safety regulations.

What’s On Offer
  • Stable, long-term subcontract work with a reputable national contractor.
  • Monday to Friday schedule, with optional weekend work.
  • 6-month rolling contract with the potential for multi-year engagement.
  • Rates up to £35 per hour, with enhanced overtime rates available.
  • Outside IR35 – weekly payments every Friday.

What We’re Looking For
  • Proven experience servicing emergency lighting and fire alarm systems.
  • Strong diagnostic and fault-finding abilities.
  • Familiarity with industry standards BS 5266 and BS 5839.
  • Electrical isolation qualification preferred.
  • Experience in housing, education, or care environments.
  • Must hold a current DBS check.

job.title: Health & Safety Provider
job.description:
Health & Safety Advisor – Data Centre ProjectsLocation: Stockholm, Sweden

Contract: 12-month rolling contract
Start Date: October 2026
Level: Intermediate – Senior
Sector: Data Centres / Major Construction

V7 Recruitment are currently recruiting for Intermediate and Senior Health & Safety Advisors to join a major General Contractor delivering large-scale data centre projects across Sweden and the wider Nordics.
The successful candidates will join the project team on a 12-month rolling contract, with the opportunity to either move into a permanent position after the initial 12 months or continue contracting.
The client has a significant pipeline of data centre projects across Sweden, providing strong long-term opportunities for the right candidates.

The RoleAs a Health & Safety Advisor, you will be site-based and responsible for supporting the delivery of a safe working environment across a large-scale data centre construction project in Stockholm.
You will work closely with the project management team, contractors and subcontractors to ensure Health & Safety standards are maintained throughout the construction process.

Key Responsibilities
  • Support the implementation and monitoring of Health & Safety procedures across the project.
  • Conduct regular site inspections, audits and safety observations.
  • Monitor contractors and subcontractors to ensure compliance with Health & Safety requirements.
  • Review Risk Assessments, Method Statements and other Health & Safety documentation.
  • Identify potential hazards and ensure appropriate control measures are implemented.
  • Assist with the investigation of accidents, incidents and near misses.
  • Deliver toolbox talks, inductions and other Health & Safety briefings.
  • Monitor high-risk construction activities and ensure safe systems of work are followed.
  • Work closely with the wider project team to promote a positive Health & Safety culture.
  • Provide practical Health & Safety advice and guidance to site teams.
  • Support the project in maintaining compliance with relevant legislation, client requirements and industry best practice.
About You
  • Previous experience working as a Health & Safety Advisor within a large-scale construction environment.
  • Suitable for Intermediate through to Senior-level Health & Safety professionals.
  • Proven experience working on large construction sites is essential.

job.title: Appointed Person / Temporary Works Coordinator
job.description:
Lifting Appointed Person / Temporary Works Coordinator Location: Finland
Project: 250MW Greenfield Data Centre
Role Type: Contractor-Side – Civils / CSA

We are looking for an experienced Lifting Appointed Person / Temporary Works Coordinator to join the CSA/Civils delivery team on a major 250MW greenfield data centre project in Finland.

The role will have responsibility for the safe planning and coordination of lifting operations, while also supporting the management and control of temporary works across the civils and CSA package.

This is a site-based role working closely with the CSA Project Manager, Site Managers, subcontractors, lifting teams, engineers and wider project team.

The Role You will be responsible for ensuring lifting operations are properly planned, risk assessed and executed safely, while coordinating temporary works activities in accordance with the project requirements and relevant standards.

The successful candidate will be comfortable working directly with civils subcontractors and site teams, reviewing documentation, coordinating activities and ensuring that lifting and temporary works are properly controlled before works commence.

Key Responsibilities Lifting – Appointed Person • Act as the Lifting Appointed Person for the project and take responsibility for the planning of lifting operations

• Develop and review lifting plans, lift studies and risk assessments for complex and routine lifting activities

• Determine suitable cranes, lifting equipment, accessories and configurations for planned operations

• Review ground conditions, crane positioning, access and working areas prior to lifting activities

• Coordinate with crane suppliers, lifting supervisors, banksmen/signallers and subcontractors

• Ensure lifting operations are planned in accordance with relevant legislation, project procedures and safe systems of work

• Review lifting equipment certification and ensure equipment is suitable for the planned operation

• Identify potential lifting risks and ensure appropriate control measures are implemented

• Coordinate lifting activities with other construction works to avoid clashes and unsafe interfaces

• Monitor lifting operations on site and provide technical support where required

Temporary Works Coordinator • Coordinate the planning, design, review and implementation of temporary works across the CSA/civils package

• Maintain oversight of the temporary works register and ensure temporary works are properly categorised, designed and approved

• Coordinate with temporary works designers, engineers, subcontractors and site management

• Review temporary works proposals, drawings, calculations and design information

• Ensure appropriate temporary works design checks are completed before construction

• Ensure temporary works are installed, inspected, maintained and removed in accordance with approved designs

• Support site teams with temporary works queries and technical issues

• Ensure temporary works interfaces are properly coordinated with permanent works and other construction activities

• Maintain appropriate records, inspections and approvals throughout the temporary works process

Project Coordination • Work closely with the CSA Project Manager, Site Managers, Engineers and subcontractors

• Attend construction planning and coordination meetings

• Review upcoming works and identify lifting and temporary works requirements in advance

• Ensure required documentation is in place before activities commence

• Coordinate with the wider project team to ensure lifting and temporary works activities do not impact the construction programme

• Promote a strong safety culture across all lifting and temporary works activities

• Provide practical, site-based support to the construction team

Requirements • Proven experience working as a Lifting Appointed Person on major construction projects

• Strong knowledge of lifting operations, crane planning and lifting equipment

• Previous experience coordinating temporary works on major construction projects

• Experience working within civils, CSA, industrial, infrastructure or data centre projects

• Strong understanding of lifting plans, risk assessments, method statements and temporary works documentation

• Experience coordinating subcontractors and site teams

• Ability to review technical documentation including drawings, calculations and lifting studies

• Strong understanding of construction health & safety requirements

• Comfortable working in a fast-paced, site-based environment

• Strong communication and coordination skills

Desirable Experience • Previous experience working on hyperscale data centre projects

• Experience across large-scale CSA/civils packages

• Experience managing lifting and temporary works activities on greenfield projects

• Experience working alongside major civils contractors and specialist subcontractors

• Relevant lifting/appointed person and temporary works qualifications

What We're Looking For We are looking for a practical, site-focused professional who can take ownership of lifting operations and temporary works coordination across a large-scale CSA package.

The ideal candidate will be confident dealing with subcontractors and site teams, technically competent, highly organised and able to identify potential issues before they become problems.

This is a hands-on position for someone who is comfortable being on site, reviewing documentation, coordinating teams and making sure lifting and temporary works are properly planned and controlled.

The role is based in Finland and will require regular site presence.

job.title: Senior Mechanical Project Engineer
job.description:
# Senior Mechanical Project Engineer

**Location:** Finland
**Project:** 250MW Greenfield Data Centre
**Role Type:** Client-Side

We are hiring a **Senior Mechanical Project Engineer** to join our team in Finland to support the delivery of a **250MW greenfield data centre**.

This is a **client-side role**. You will represent the owner and take responsibility for the mechanical scope from design development through construction, testing, commissioning, and handover.

## The Role

You will oversee the mechanical infrastructure for the project, ensuring it is designed, installed, tested, and commissioned in line with the project requirements, local regulations, and agreed programme.

You will work closely with design consultants, EPC contractors, specialist mechanical contractors, equipment vendors, and commissioning teams to make sure the mechanical systems are delivered safely, on time, and to the required standard.

## Key Responsibilities

• Manage the mechanical scope across all project phases
• Review and coordinate mechanical design documentation from consultants
• Oversee the installation and delivery of mechanical systems across the data centre
• Monitor installation of **HVAC, chilled water, cooling, ventilation, pumps, pipework and associated mechanical plant**
• Coordinate mechanical interfaces with electrical, CSA and commissioning teams
• Review equipment specifications, technical submissions, method statements and commissioning procedures
• Attend FATs and support SATs, testing and commissioning activities
• Monitor contractor progress and ensure works are delivered in line with the project programme
• Ensure compliance with Finnish regulations and international standards
• Track progress, manage risks, and resolve technical issues
• Coordinate with civil, electrical, controls and commissioning teams
• Support final testing, commissioning and handover to operations

## Requirements

• Strong experience delivering **mechanical systems on large-scale projects**
• Experience on **data centres, industrial plants, pharmaceutical facilities, power projects, or similar critical facilities**
• Solid understanding of **HVAC, cooling systems, chilled water, ventilation and mechanical services**
• Experience managing mechanical contractors, consultants and specialist vendors
• Ability to review technical designs, specifications and installation documentation
• Experience working in a client-side, EPC or main contractor environment
• Ability to manage interfaces between mechanical and other project disciplines
• Comfortable working on site and leading technical discussions
• Strong understanding of construction, testing and commissioning processes

## What We’re Looking For

We are looking for someone practical and technically strong, who understands how **large-scale mechanical and cooling systems are designed, installed and commissioned**, and who can take ownership of the mechanical package from the client side.

Experience delivering mechanical systems within a **hyperscale data centre environment** would be highly advantageous.

This role is based in **Finland** and will require regular site presence.

job.title: Business Support Administrator
job.description:
Business Support Administrator - Manchester (M1)

Company and Role Overview

V7 Recruitment is a Manchester-based recruitment agency specialising in Engineering and Technical industries across the UK and Europe.

We have grown quickly by challenging how recruitment has traditionally been done, and we need someone equally driven to help keep that growth moving.
This is not a background administrative role where every day looks the same.

As a Team Administrator, you will sit at the centre of a fast-moving recruitment business, coordinating international travel, managing assignment documentation, resolving candidate queries and ensuring the details behind every placement are handled properly.

You will work closely with our Senior Leadership Team, consultants, candidates and internal departments, often becoming the person people rely on when something needs organising, answering or fixing.

The role would suit someone who enjoys responsibility, communicates confidently and takes pride in staying one step ahead.

Key Responsibilities
  • Travel and Accommodation Coordination: Organise flights, accommodation and travel arrangements for candidates working across the UK and Europe, responding quickly when plans change.
  • Assignment Administration: Coordinate assignment schedules and documentation, ensuring candidates and internal teams have the correct information at the right time.
  • Contract Support: Assist with contracts and act as a point of contact for contract-related questions.
  • Payroll and Expense Queries: Support candidates with payroll and expense queries, working with the relevant internal teams to resolve issues accurately and efficiently.
  • Tracking and Reporting: Maintain expense trackers, assignment records and administrative systems, ensuring information remains accurate and up to date.
  • Candidate Support: Support candidates before and throughout their assignments, providing a reliable point of contact when they need guidance.
  • Inbound Call Handling: Handle incoming calls with confidence and professionalism, resolving queries where possible or directing them to the right person.
  • Senior Leadership Support: Provide responsive administrative support to the Senior Leadership Team and help ensure the wider business continues to run smoothly.
What We Are Looking For

We are looking for someone who does more than wait for the next task.
You will be proactive, organised and comfortable taking ownership in an environment where priorities can move quickly.

You will also have:
  • Previous experience in an administrative, operations or business support role.
  • Experience maintaining trackers, records and administrative systems.
  • A confident and professional telephone manner.
  • Strong organisational skills and close attention to detail.
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills.
  • The ability to prioritise competing tasks without losing sight of the detail.
  • Confidence dealing with candidates and responding to contract, payroll and expense queries.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office and other administrative software.
  • A practical, collaborative approach and the confidence to solve problems independently.
  • Experience within recruitment or another fast-paced, service-led business would be beneficial, but attitude, organisation and ownership are just as important.
Why Join V7?
  • You will be joining an ambitious business where good ideas are listened to, responsibility is encouraged and people are trusted to make an impact.
  • This is an opportunity to take ownership of a varied role, work closely with senior leaders and become a key part of how V7 operates as the business continues to grow.
Working Conditions
  • This position is based in our Manchester office.
  • Working hours are 08:30-17:30 Monday to Thursday and 08:30-16:00 on Friday, with the option to work from home on Wednesday.
How to Apply

Ready to take ownership of a role where your work genuinely keeps the business moving?

Please submit your CV to workforus@v7recruitment.com.

job.title: Electrical Package Manager
job.description:
Electrical Package Manager

Location: Vaasa, Finland
Sector: Hyperscale Data Centres | Mission Critical Construction
Employment Type: Permanent

The Opportunity

An established Tier 1 contractor is delivering one of Europe's largest hyperscale data centre programmes and is seeking an experienced Electrical Package Manager to join the project delivery team in Vaasa.

This is a site-based leadership role responsible for the successful delivery of major electrical packages from pre-construction through to commissioning. Working as part of a high-performing project team, you will take ownership of programme, technical coordination, subcontractor management, commercial performance, quality, safety and client interface, ensuring the electrical package is delivered safely, on programme and to the highest industry standards.

This opportunity offers long-term career progression on complex mission-critical projects within one of Europe's fastest-growing construction sectors.

Key Responsibilities
  • Take full ownership of the electrical package throughout the construction lifecycle.
  • Coordinate design information, technical submissions, procurement and installation activities.
  • Manage electrical subcontractors, ensuring works are delivered safely, efficiently and in line with programme.
  • Drive progress on site, monitoring productivity, sequencing and resource levels.
  • Work closely with the Project Manager, design consultants, client representatives and wider project delivery team to achieve key project milestones.
  • Oversee installation, testing, energisation and commissioning activities through to successful handover.
  • Manage package budgets, variations, valuations and commercial performance.
  • Ensure materials, plant and equipment are procured, tracked and delivered in accordance with programme requirements.
  • Lead site quality processes, inspections, snagging and close-out activities to achieve a high-quality finish.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation, reporting and package tracking throughout delivery.
  • Champion a strong Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental (QHSE) culture across the project.
  • Ensure full compliance with company procedures, industry standards and client requirements.
About You

You will have proven experience delivering complex electrical packages on major construction projects and be comfortable leading multidisciplinary site teams in a fast-paced environment.
You will ideally possess:
  • Previous experience as an Electrical Package Manager, Senior Electrical Engineer, Electrical Construction Manager or similar.
  • Strong background delivering large-scale construction projects within data centres, pharmaceuticals, semiconductor, battery, industrial, manufacturing, power or other mission-critical environments.
  • Experience managing electrical subcontractors throughout the full construction lifecycle.
  • Strong understanding of electrical systems installation, testing and commissioning.
  • Ability to manage programme, commercial performance and technical coordination simultaneously.
  • Excellent leadership, communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Commitment to delivering projects safely, on time and to the highest quality standards.
What's on Offer
  • Opportunity to work on one of Europe's most significant hyperscale data centre programmes.
  • Long-term pipeline of secured projects.
  • Excellent career progression within a growing international contractor.
  • Competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.
  • Collaborative, high-performing project environment.
  • Exposure to technically complex, industry-leading mission-critical projects.
If you're an experienced Electrical Package Manager looking to play a key role in delivering major data centre infrastructure, I'd be pleased to discuss this opportunity with you in confidence.

job.title: Graduate Electrical Engineer
job.description:
- Graduate Electrical Engineer
- Perfect for a graduate or junior engineer
- HUGE career development for a world leading engineering company
- £32k - £35k & bonus, 25 day holiday, strong pension,
 
So you’ve just graduated – congratulations! After 3 or 4 years of good academic work you’re itching to put in to the “real world”.
 
But what next? It can be pretty daunting going into your first job, that’s going to shape your career & life, so pretty important to get right…
 
So how does coming into a world leading engineering company sound? 1 where you will have seen their products already and have an incredible track record of developing potential in to the finest engineering talent?
 
On that basis, we are looking to bring in a sharp electrical grad who wants to learn, develop and use this as a stepping stone in wherever you want to go in the engineering world. A rare opportunity for a long term career.
 
It’s all about you:
We don’t want someone who can “do it all”, we will train you there. But we do want someone who has a very good electrical engineering foundation who wants evolve your academic knowledge into engineering knowledge in the real world.
 
So as long as you have the drive, personality and motivation to want to lean and carry on your journey, we would love to hear from you.
 
The role:
This role is almost a mix of Design Engineering and Project Engineering. We manufacture some of the highest level electrical equipment (that goes around the world) and when a client needs something bespoke, we take over and guide them.
 
That’s where you come in (after a lot of training of course).
 
So a role where you are working with the end clients, seeing what they need leading these projects through design before they are manufactured (which is done on site, so you see it all come to life).
 
What next?
Sound like an opportunity that appeals? Simply hit apply and let’s have a chat. Look forward to hearing your story.
